metadata.title: Captain Kind and the Great World Wobble
metadata.subtitle: A Little Sip, a Soft Breath, a Big Kindness
metadata.author: Giggle & Snooze
metadata.blurb: When peas, oranges, and even the moon begin to bounce, a towel-caped hero discovers the world has hiccups. A little kindness brings the neighborhood together for a gentle pause before bedtime.
metadata.dedication: For every little helper who makes room for someone.

pages.title: Peas, Please!
pages.text:
At supper, one pea bounced off Captain Kind’s spoon.
Then every pea bounced—boing, boing, boing!
“Stay for supper!” giggled the captain.
pages.prompt: A curly-haired child with warm brown skin wears raspberry pajamas and an apricot towel cape at a cozy kitchen table; green peas bounce over a buttercream bowl, and the child laughs with spoon in hand. pages.title: A Round Surprise
pages.text:
Outside, balls and oranges bounced too.
Even the moon bobbed above the roofs.
Captain Kind tied the towel cape: “A wobble needs a helper!”

pages.title: The Catching Plan
pages.text:
Captain Kind held a basket under the bouncing oranges.
Boing, they popped right out again!
“Catching won’t stop this wobble,” said the captain.

pages.title: Hic, Little World
pages.text:
Captain Kind put an ear to the grass.
“Hic!” said the ground—and up went every round thing.
“The world has hiccups!” whispered the captain.

pages.title: A Little Pause
pages.text:
“When I have hiccups, I take a quiet pause,” said Captain Kind.
So the captain sat beside the bouncing ball.
“Pause with me, little world.”

pages.title: A Sip to Share
pages.text:
“And a little sip of water feels nice.”
Captain Kind brought a jug and cups for the neighbors.
“Your own cup, a little sip—come sit with me.”

pages.title: Make Room
pages.text:
One neighbor called another, and another brought a cushion.
Soon the street was sitting together.
“Room for you, a sip for you, a pause for everyone.”

pages.title: In…and Out
pages.text:
“Breathe in, like smelling a flower.”
“Breathe out, like cooling your soup.”
Together they breathed, slow and soft—and the bouncing grew smaller.

pages.title: One Tiny Hic
pages.text:
The peas rested, the balls rested, and the oranges rested.
The moon gave one last tiny hic!
Then it settled into a cloud, and everyone whispered, “Good night, world.”

pages.title: Captain Cozy
pages.text:
Captain Kind hung up the towel cape and snuggled into bed.
“A little kindness brought us together,” the captain murmured.
Outside, the world was still, and inside, the captain slept.
